base: Draw ONE standalone horizontal 3/4 overhead RPG Maker / tsukuru game map concept, map09 'Old sanctuary sinking into sand', same game as reference images. References1-2 mandatory ART STYLE ONLY: clean painted pixel-clusters, crisp varied material-colored contour, warm cream/honey stone with peach reflections and umber overlaps, restrained weathered surfaces, readable floor tops and upright walls. Do NOT import lush vegetation, furniture, well, sky, roof terrace or domestic clutter. Reference3 supplies architectural identity ONLY of the LOW sanctuary at UPPER LEFT of its desert, NOT the pyramid or circular disc. This new map is its close walkable precinct: horizontal around 2:1, no horizon/sky/distant panorama. An abandoned SMALL ROOFLESS sanctuary courtyard at character scale, a few short worn round stone columns, low cream sandstone boundary walls, large irregular surviving floor slabs partly covered by encroaching sand, subtle geometric floor border disappearing beneath sand. Roof absent; no enclosed interior doorway, grand temple facade, twin pylons, intact roof or extra rooms. Damage concentrated in ONE large breach in one side wall, few large fallen blocks only there, not scattered rubble everywhere. Broad walkable center and access around each low column; clear wide entrance/return to desert01 at bottom. On one side a low accessible worn relief panel with just three distinguishable simple nonreligious motifs (circle, wavy lines, triangle), across the courtyard a low plain stone plinth as a FUTURE removable glyph-panel mounting site; keep its top plain, not a completed puzzle. Small subtle disturbed sand patch behind/aside plinth for future excavation, no treasure or object baked in. These are layout placements, no numbers, solution arrows, text or UI. No ANKH, looped crosses, religious crosses, winged discs, statues, pyramid, fountain, pool, obelisk, palm, grass, plants, tent, market goods, furniture, glowing magic, people. Quiet forgotten ceremonial court with generous empty space, not a dramatic rubble field or maze. Pale beige sand distinct from warm cream stone, coherent sunlight, no orange wash, purple shadow filter, white piping, constant black outlines, microcrack/pebble noise, photorealism or 3D render. All fixed structure shares 3/4 camera and contact shadows. ONE fully painted concept, no montage. Variant layout:
variants: 1 Broad shallow rectangular court with rear low relief wall, four short column remnants arranged loosely near corners, wide south central opening. Large breach on left wall with sand flowing inward from upper-left. Relief panel on rear-right wall accessible on its south side; low plain plinth left of center clear of breach, excavation patch behind it. Exposed floor primarily right half, quiet sandy left half.

2 Asymmetrical L-shaped surviving walls along top and left, open south entry and major broken east wall admitting a broad smooth sand tongue. Three short column remnants on outer edge, not blocking center. Relief on left wall, plain low plinth at upper-right inside open court opposite it, small excavation patch beside plinth. Large surviving central floor fragments, no fully outlined rectangular carpet.

3 Wider transverse court, low rear wall with accessible relief at upper-left. Two short round columns in front of rear wall and one broken column at lower-right edge. Major breach concentrated upper-right with a few large blocks and sand intrusion. Low plain plinth lower-right of center with excavation patch beyond it; broad empty central crossing and wide lower-left entry. Floor pattern visible only as two disconnected segments through sand.

4 Slightly oblique compact court with low intact right wall and broken rear-left corner, four low unequal-height column stumps spaced at periphery. Entry bottom-right wide and simple, no gatehouse. Relief on right wall; plain low mounting plinth at left inner edge away from collapse, excavation patch behind. Sand covers back-left, open surviving paving toward lower-right. Emphasize calm asymmetry and clear paths.
